General.name: translate
General.description: Translates text (English to 36 languages). Replying to a message translates it.

leveling.label: Leveling
leveling.desc: Activity leveling, XP tracking, rank cards, and leaderboard rankings.

Leveling.name: disable
Leveling.description: Disables level-up notifications for this server.
Leveling.note: Users will still gain XP and roles, but no level-up messages are sent.

Leveling.name: disable
Leveling.description: Disables a command for this server (owner/creator/whitelist only).

params.name: command
params.desc: Command to disable (subcommands like `welcome test` work). Omit to list disabled commands. `level` disables the leveling system.

Leveling.note: guild owner, creator, or whitelisted users only. `.enable <command>` turns it back on. `.disable level` is creator-only.

Leveling.name: enable
Leveling.description: Enables level-up notifications for this server.
Leveling.note: A level-up message is sent in the channel when someone levels up.

Leveling.name: enable
Leveling.description: Re-enables a disabled command for this server (owner/creator/whitelist only).

params.name: command
params.desc: Command to re-enable. Omit to list disabled commands. `level` re-enables the leveling system.

Leveling.note: guild owner, creator, or whitelisted users only.

Leveling.name: givexp
Leveling.description: Manually gives XP to a user (admin only).

params.name: amount
params.desc: Amount of XP to give.

params.name: user
params.desc: The target member. Defaults to yourself.

Leveling.name: levelleaderboard

params.name: top
params.desc: How many entries to show. Defaults to 10, capped at 200.

Leveling.note: Displays the top XP earners in the server.

Leveling.name: levelnotify
Leveling.description: Toggles or checks level-up notification status for this server.

params.name: action
params.desc: `enable` or `disable`. Omit to check current status.

Leveling.note: Users still gain XP and roles even when notifications are disabled.

subcommands.name: disable
subcommands.description: Disables level-up notifications for this server.

subcommands.name: enable
subcommands.description: Enables level-up notifications for this server.

Leveling.name: levelrole

params.name: level
params.desc: The level at which to award the role.

params.name: role
params.desc: The role to assign.

params.name: level

Leveling.name: rank

params.name: user
params.desc: The member to check. Defaults to yourself.

Leveling.note: Shows current level, XP progress, and server rank.

params.name: level
params.desc: The level to remove the role reward from.
